description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations and a class 'FieldHooks' related to the Field API, including help, cron, entity field storage info, bundle info, delete, configuration import steps, form alterations, and entity field configuration hooks.

classes.name: FieldHooks
classes.description: A class implementing various Drupal hooks related to the Field API, including help, cron, entity storage info, bundle info, delete, config import steps, form alterations, and entity field configuration hooks.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information for the field module, including overview, terminology, usage, and module support details.

methods.name: cron
methods.description: Performs scheduled cleanup of deleted field data during cron runs.

methods.name: entityFieldStorageInfo
methods.description: Returns information about field storage configurations for a given entity type.

methods.name: entityBundleFieldInfo
methods.description: Provides information about fields attached to a specific entity bundle, utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: entityBundleDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup when an entity bundle is deleted, including removing associated fields and updating entity reference fields.

methods.name: configImportStepsAlter
methods.description: Adds a step to purge field data during configuration import if modules are being uninstalled.

methods.name: formConfigAdminImportFormAlter
methods.description: Displays warnings in the admin import form if field data will be permanently removed during config sync.

methods.name: fieldConfigInsert
methods.description: Rebuilds entity type displays when a new field configuration is inserted, unless during sync.

methods.name: fieldStorageConfigUpdate
methods.description: Resets handler settings for entity reference fields when the target type changes, unless during sync.

methods.name: fieldConfigCreate
methods.description: Sets the correct handler plugin ID for entity reference fields upon creation, unless during sync.

methods.name: fieldConfigPresave
methods.description: Logs a critical message if an entity reference field no longer has valid target bundles, unless during sync.
